svg.title: 1D half-open slices and 2D axis reductions
svg.desc: Left panel shows 1D array a = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50] with 0-based indices 0..4 and negative indices -5..-1, where half-open a[1:4] returns [20, 30, 40] (4 excluded) and a[::2] returns [10, 30, 50]. Right panel shows a (2, 3) grid [[1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]] where axis=0 sums down rows to [11, 22, 33] and axis=1 sums across columns to [6, 60].
